{{short description|American mathematician}}
'''Edward "Ted" Wilfred Odell, Jr.''' (15 March 1947, in [[Pleasantville, New York]] – 9 January 2013, in [[Houston, Texas]]) was an American mathematician, specializing in the theory of [[Banach space]]s.<ref name=CV>{{cite web|url=http://www.ma.utexas.edu/users/odell/Vita-Web-version-rev2-2-12.pdf|title=Edward W. Odell|website=utexas.edu}}</ref>

Odell received in 1969 in his B.S. degree from the [[State University of New York at Binghamton]] and in 1975 his Ph.D. degree from the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] under [[William B. Johnson (mathematician)|William Buhmann Johnson]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=13150|title=Edward Wilfred Odell, Jr.}}</ref> From 1975 to 1977 Odell was a [[Josiah Willard Gibbs]] Instructor at [[Yale University]]. He became in 1977 an assistant professor, in 1981 an associate professor, and in 1990 a full professor at the [[University of Texas at Austin]]. He was the author or coauthor of 84 articles.<ref name=CV/>

In 1994 Odell was an Invited Speaker of the [[International Congress of Mathematicians|ICM]] in Zurich.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.mathunion.org/icm-plenary-and-invited-speakers?combine=odell|title=ICM Plenary and Invited Speakers|publisher=International Mathematical Union|access-date=2024-05-11}}</ref> In 2012 he was elected a Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{cite journal|url=https://www.ams.org/profession/ams-fellows/rnoti-p631.pdf|title=Fellows of the AMS: Inaugural class|journal=Notices of the American Mathematical Society|pages=631–637|date=May 2013|volume=60|issue=5}}</ref>

==Selected publications==
*with W. B. Johnson: "Subspaces and quotients of ''l<sub>p</sub>⊕l<sub>2</sub>'' and ''X<sub>p</sub>''." Acta Mathematica 147, no. 1 (1981): 117–147. {{doi|10.1007/BF02392872}}
*with Richard Haydon and Mireille Levy: On sequences without weak* convergent convex block subsequences. Proc. Amer. Math. Soc. 100 (1987), 94–98 {{doi|10.1090/S0002-9939-1987-0883407-1}}
*with Thomas  Schlumprecht [https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q102216314]: "The distortion problem." Acta Mathematica 173, no. 2 (1994): 259–281. {{doi|10.1007/BF02398436}}
*with Thomas  Schlumprecht : Asymptotic properties of Banach spaces under renormings. J. Amer. Math. Soc. 11 (1998), 175–188 {{doi|10.1090/S0894-0347-98-00251-3}}
*with Thomas  Schlumprecht: Trees and branches in Banach spaces. Trans. Amer. Math. Soc. 354 (2002), 4085–4108 {{doi|10.1090/S0002-9947-02-02984-7}}
*with Hans-Olav Tylli: Weakly compact approximation in Banach spaces. Trans. Amer. Math. Soc. 357 (2005), 1125–1159 {{doi|10.1090/S0002-9947-04-03684-0}}
*with B. Sari, Th. Schlumprecht, and B. Zheng: Systems formed by translates of one element in <math>L_{p}(\mathbb{R})</math>. Trans. Amer. Math. Soc. 363 (2011), 6505–6529 {{doi|10.1090/S0002-9947-2011-05305-5}}
